functions-premium-always-billed-instance.title: A Premium plan costs money even when nothing runs
functions-premium-always-billed-instance.body: Every Functions Premium plan has at least one billed instance around the clock, idle or not. For a non-production or occasional workload, the Consumption or Flex Consumption plan may cost far less because you are not charged while the app is idle.

citation.quote: Every premium plan always has at least one active (billed) instance.

functions-premium-reserve-steady.title: Steady Premium usage can be committed
functions-premium-reserve-steady.body: This Premium plan is priced pay-as-you-go but you expect steady usage. Microsoft advises reserving capacity for Elastic Premium plans when the workload is predictable; compare the savings plan option in this estimate.

citation.quote: Reserve capacity for Elastic Premium plans or Dedicated App Service plans if your workload is predictable.

functions-premium-zone-redundancy-two-in.title: Zone redundancy needs two always-ready instances
functions-premium-zone-redundancy-two-in.body: You asked for zone resilience, but this Premium plan has a single always-ready instance. Microsoft states zone redundancy for Premium plans requires at least two always-ready instances, and both are billed.

citation.quote: Zone redundancy for Premium plans requires a minimum of two always-ready instances.
